specific_points_reassessed: The infinite-measure decreasing sum retains a uniform 3/4 strict margin, L1 finiteness and local C-infinity convergence on each fixed block; finite recursive constraints and the unbounded square-root weighted scale allow the chosen future scales.

The full invariant smooth upper bound uses the nonnegative determinant density, closed base fiber flux and the radial one-dimensional derivative estimate; the last estimate is not available in the general class.
Capacity comparison, compact-group convolution and bounded mixed-degree products retain the original nonclosed background rather than importing an unbounded closed theorem.
Truncation removal bounds actual mass at the level set and the pole set using Q_(K-1); no unproved interchange of limits is used.

The actual critical capacity-convergent sequence has cores in shrinking neighborhoods of the pole divisor, and Portmanteau forces a positive polar mass in a weak cluster; the defining non-pluripolar measure of the limit gives that divisor zero mass.
